title: Combat Dock
description: A bottom-docked combat console that appears when your combat starts: initiative ribbon, your abilities with ability-first targeting (click the power, then the token), range checks, reaction cards, and a movement circle showing how far you can still move this turn. Works on plain D&D 5e; Bad Eden worlds load it through bbttcc-territory.

recommends.reason: the dock shows the Surge heat meter and opens the Surge menu
